Definition: Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Rehob is a city in the north, Beth-rehob, where the spies' journey reached its end and where Asher's border ran. The name also belongs to the father of Hadadezer king of Zobah, whom David struck, and to an Israelite who sealed the covenant under Nehemiah.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that one name can hold a city, a king's father and a covenant keeper, and God knows each of them apart.
